title: Mediterranean Sevaiiya Pilaf
description: A flavorful and light Mediterranean-inspired pilaf dish made with sevaiiya and a hint of Mediterranean spices.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add chopped garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the Mediterranean Pilaf Rice Mix and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add 1 cup of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed.
Stir in dried oregano, salt, and chopped parsley.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Cook the sevaiiya according to package instructions and serve alongside the pilaf.
